sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, centroid x/y) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/princess/royal-princess/v6/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one <path class="cabin-shape" data-cabin> per stateroom. UNLIKE Royal Caribbean, Princess deckmaps SVGs do NOT encode stateroom category: every cabin path is fill="#fff" with a black stroke over a monochrome line-art background PNG, so category cannot be read from colour. Category was instead derived by spatially registering each deckmaps cabin centroid against the category-coded HTML image-map regions (<area title="Category XX">) on cruisedeckplans.com Royal-Princess deck-by-deck pages, using a per-deck bbox-affine fit with 4-flip disambiguation (minimising rect-to-nearest-cabin distance) then nearest-region category assignment. Per-deck mean rect->cabin registration error was ~7-12px. Category-code legend (IA-IF, BA-BF/BV-BZ, DA-DF/DV/DW/D4, MA-MF/M1/M6, S3/S4/S5) taken from cruisedeckplans category tooltips and collapsed to marketing groupings.

notes.completeness: geometry-exact: all 1780 staterooms across the 8 guest decks (8,9,10,11,12,14,15,16). Per-deck counts (8:229,9:229,10:278,11:270,12:258,14:220,15:232,16:64) come straight from the deckmaps cabin-shape paths and match the SVG path counts exactly. Total 1780 matches Royal Princess's real published stateroom count (~1,780). No cabin number or position was invented.
notes.category: APPROXIMATE / DERIVED, not from the geometry source. Princess deckmaps SVGs carry no category colour (all fills #fff), so each cabin's category was assigned by spatially matching its centroid to cruisedeckplans.com's category-coded deck-plan regions (per-deck affine registration, mean error ~7-12px). Accuracy is highest inside contiguous category blocks and lowest at category boundaries and in sparse-region decks (nearest-region fallback). The finer Princess sub-codes were collapsed to marketing groups (IA-IF=Interior; BA-BF and obstructed BV-BZ=Balcony; DA-DF and obstructed DV/DW=Deluxe Balcony; D4=Premium Deluxe Balcony; MA-MF=Mini-Suite; M1/M6=Reserve Collection Mini-Suite; S3/S4=Penthouse Suite; S5=Premium Suite). Treat individual-cabin category as a strong estimate, not a booking-grade guarantee.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. Bow assumed at the low-y end of each deck SVG (consistent Princess sequence-number clustering). section = forward/mid/aft thirds of each deck's occupied length. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED heuristic. Geometric split of the beam at each deck's centre-x; low x = port, high x = starboard, assuming a standard viewed-from-above, bow-up deck plan. Cross-checked against Princess cabin-number parity (even=port / odd=starboard): see reported agreement. Could be uniformly mirrored if deckmaps drew the plan flipped; validate against a known cabin before relying on it.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps/cruisedeckplans geometry carries no obstructed-view flag here; obstructed=false for all (source does not encode obstruction; NOT asserted as guaranteed clear-view). Note some balcony sub-codes (BV-BZ, DV/DW) are cruisedeckplans "obstructed" variants collapsed into their base category.

colorLegend.#fff: No category encoding. Princess deckmaps deck SVGs render every cabin shape as white fill (#fff) with a black stroke over a monochrome background raster; category is NOT conveyed by colour (contrast Royal Caribbean). Category in this file was derived externally from cruisedeckplans.com - see sourceDetail/notes.
